title: Work through a reading lesson
content:
For a learner with a prepared reading lesson.
1. Open the reading activity for the prepared story.
2. Start reading using the assigned reading mode and speed. Modes include word-by-word, line-by-line and full-page, with automatic or manual timing.
3. Complete the reading activity; its result includes reading speed in words per minute (WPM).
4. Use Start comprehension when it is offered.
Expected result: the reading result is shown before continuing. Which reading screen are you on now?
